inputFields.name: publishItemMode
inputFields.description: The publish item mode. Do not specify together with PublishSiteMode parameter.

inputFields.name: publishRelatedItems
inputFields.description: Indicates whether to publish related items for publish item operation.

inputFields.name: publishSiteMode
inputFields.description: The publish site mode. Do not specify together with PublishItemMode parameter.

inputFields.name: publishSubItems
inputFields.description: Indicates whether to publish sub-items for publish item operation.

inputFields.name: rootItemId
inputFields.description: The ID of the root item for publish item operation. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: rootItemPath
inputFields.description: The path of the root item for publish item operation.
